game.title: Mad Max
game.build_notes: Verified on Windows 10, 2026-09-03, with our dxgi.dll proxy present. Ran windowed at 784x561. Driven entirely by external synthetic input.

api_notes: Standard primitives: scancodes, KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY for arrows, foreground first, BitBlt for capture.
The window title is exactly 'Mad Max'. NOTE the process owns several windows (DIEmWin, Default IME, MSCTFIME UI); match on the VISIBLE one.
The window does not exist for the first several seconds after launch - the process starts, then creates it. A find-window failure right after launch means 'still starting', not 'wrong title'.

PROBE HOTKEYS ARE NUMPAD AND NUMLOCK-INDEPENDENT: the cbfp probe reads GetAsyncKeyState and accepts either the numpad VK or the navigation VK (NUMPAD4 or LEFT = mark A, NUMPAD5 or CLEAR = mark B, NUMPAD3 or PGUP = dump). Send NON-EXTENDED scancodes 0x4B/0x4C/0x51 and it works whatever NumLock is set to.

bindings.action: advance the title screen ('PRESS ANY BUTTON')

bindings.notes: Menus show 'NAVIGATE / SELECT' hints; Esc backs out.

states.name: legal_splash
states.detect: Publisher/middleware logos with a spinner bottom-right. Frame delta near 0.1 - nearly static.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: RESUME GAME / NEW GAME / LOAD GAME / SETTINGS / WBPLAY / DOWNLOADABLE CONTENT / CREDITS / EXIT GAME over a desert vista.

states.name: pause_menu
states.detect: Tabbed screen (PAUSE / BIOS / MAX / GARAGE / LEGEND / COLLECTIBLES). GAME column: RESUME GAME / AUTOSAVES / SETTINGS / EXIT TO MAIN MENU. Log column includes CAPTURE MODE.

states.name: gameplay
states.detect: Third-person over-shoulder, minimap bottom-left, objective text top-left, weapon indicator bottom-right.

steps: wait ~40s through the legal splash (the window may not exist for the first seconds)
main menu appears with RESUME GAME already highlighted
wait ~60s for the world to load
Down x3 to EXIT TO MAIN MENU - VERIFY the highlight
confirm dialog: Enter = YES directly, Esc = NO (no navigation needed)
Down x7 to EXIT GAME - VERIFY, NEW GAME sits directly under RESUME GAME
routes.notes: Process exits ~2s after the final confirm.

console.notes: Not investigated. This project drives the game through its own dxgi.dll proxy, whose probes are triggered by numpad hotkeys and which writes madmax_vr_proxy_log.txt in the game folder.

capture_mode.notes: CAPTURE MODE is listed in the pause menu's Log column. Photo modes usually carry a free camera, which is what a VR conversion wants. NOT opened - this is a menu label, i.e. a lead and not evidence.

hazards.hazard: NEW GAME sits directly under RESUME GAME on the main menu
hazards.notes: Both the title menu default and the exit path pass by it. Navigate, capture, verify the highlight, then commit.

hazards.hazard: The window does not exist immediately after launch
hazards.notes: MadMax.exe appears in the process list several seconds before it creates its visible window. A find-window failure at that moment is a timing artefact, not a wrong title - retry rather than concluding the game did not start.

hazards.hazard: The process owns several non-game windows
hazards.notes: DIEmWin, Default IME (x2) and MSCTFIME UI all belong to MadMax.exe and are invisible. Filter on IsWindowVisible or you may attach to the wrong one.
